bodyParagraphs: Welcome everyone to a revolution in the market. The Porsche OEM exhaust valve controller by Valvetronic Designs. This setup is a complete plug and play unit for most Porsches that give the driver full control over the exhaust valves. For cars like the 991.1 Carrera S without sports exhaust, the factory exhaust has valves, but there is no button to open and close these valves. Our controller puts the power in your hands. These Controllers FIT ALL PORSCHES WITH VACUUM EXHAUST VALVES. For all Porsche enthusiasts interested in controlling their exhaust valves this is the product for you. The installation is incredibly simple and is completely plug and play.
100% REVERSABLE, ALWAYS ABLE TO RETURN TO STOCK AT ANY TIME

products.title: Truck/SUV Valved Muffler Kit
bodyParagraphs: Will this fit my vehicle?

Do your neighbors despise your cold start in the morning? Do the police give you a hard time because your truck is loud? Does your significant other hate riding in your vehicle because the drone is too loud? Maybe you just want to make your vehicle a bit louder with the option to make it sound docile without compromising. Then the Valvetronic Designs Truck/SUV Muffler Kit is the perfect solution for you. Loud when you want, quiet when you need to be, all at the touch of a button! Why is Valvetronic Designs' Universal Valved Muffler Kit Different?

Welcome to a sound revelation for all truck/SUV enthusiasts. At Valvetronic Designs, we believe everyone should have the opportunity to enjoy incredible exhaust sound sound and have the flexibility to choose when that sound is experienced. Any truck or SUV should have that perfect sound, and it is a vital part of the vehicle's experience. Many of these vehicles have great powertrains, but from the factory, they are left wheezing as they pass by. The ability to choose when your truck is loud or quiet is crucial.

Unlike traditional exhaust systems, our product not only improves the sound of a vehicle’s exhaust, but also allows the driver to revert back to stock sound at a moment’s notice. Our exhausts allow the driver the freedom to enjoy their vehicle when the opportunity is right, and switch to stock-like sound when the family is in the car, or when they do not want to bother their neighbors.
For those who enjoy hitting the trails, Valvetronic Design’s truck mufflers are a more flexible exhaust for less. Allowing drone-free road trips, yet exciting off-roading experiences.

For those who enjoy the sporty versions of their family SUV, Valvetronic Designs’ Valved Muffler kits allow for high-performance trucks to sound sporty and aggressive when the driver wants to have a more exciting drive experience, but also allow for a drone-free daily driving experience.

We have developed the Truck/SUV valved muffler to be the perfect application for trucks and SUVs to give great power, performance, and ultimate flexibility. Whether your truck is your daily vehicle or you're building a pre-runner to tackle the dunes, this flexible exhaust solution allows you to have that perfect sound when you want to hear your vehicle sing, and a quiet experience when the sound must be kept to a minimum.
Key Developments:

This product development was procured from a need to offer a valved experience to all vehicles. Our mufflers give a far more dynamic experience than any other option on the market. Quality is of the utmost importance. Our chambered muffler configuration allows for a quiet, docile experience when the valves are closed. Additionally, an internal resonance chamber is built into the muffler to help remove unrefined frequencies from the exhaust. This means you get only raw sound and no unwanted frequencies inside the cabin.
Valvetronic Vs. The Competition:

Stemming from the key developments of the product there are many reasons individuals from around the world utilize the Valvetronic Designs universal muffler kit. Compared to a traditional exhaust cutout, this product offers a much safer and more dynamic experience. Exhaust cutouts have the tendency to rust, break prematurely, and release harmful gases and heat underneath the center of the vehicle which is very dangerous. This could lead to premature wear of suspension and other components, or possibly worse. Valvetronic mufflers are designed to be used throughout the exhaust system and offer a safer experience. Additionally, the utilization of vacuum exhaust valves ensures that this kit will last and you will not have problems with electronic component failure like most of the competition. In our developments, we do not compromise, and neither should you.
Here is how it works:

Mufflers come with a vacuum control box and vacuum line allowing for an easy install. The mufflers install just like any muffler, but plug in the valves with the supplied vacuum tubing and BOOM! you can now control your car's sound on the fly. In the past, this technology was reserved for supercars but not anymore.
Warranty:
Valvetronic Designs Universal Valved Muffler Kits come with a 1 year warranty. Details about this warranty can be found on our Return and Shipping page.

bodyParagraphs: The Porsche Cayenne 9Y0 platform is one of the most versatile performance SUVs on the market, offered with both six cylinder and eight cylinder engines. Whether you are behind the wheel of a base V6 or a powerful Cayenne Turbo, the factory exhaust leaves much of the car’s potential untapped. At Valvetronic Designs we developed a system from the ground up to bring out the very best in sound and performance while maintaining everyday refinement.
Purpose-Driven Engineering

Constructed from premium T304 stainless steel, this exhaust system is engineered to deliver uncompromised sound quality with no drone and no unwanted frequencies. Larger piping improves flow and responsiveness, while the system integrates seamlessly with the factory electronic valve operation for rapid and precise control. With valves closed the Cayenne remains subdued, ideal for long highway drives or discreet city use. Open the valves and the SUV transforms, producing an aggressive tone that builds with throttle input and delivers the excitement Porsche owners demand. A quad chambered muffler ensures flexibility, smoothing out frequencies when cruising and letting the car truly sing under load.

T304 stainless steel construction for durability, tone, and performance consistency
Quad chambered muffler for a refined cruising experience with aggressive tone on demand
Larger piping size for optimized exhaust flow and throttle response
Full valve integration with rapid open and close function
Direct bolt on installation with no cutting and no welding required
The Result

The Cayenne is a Porsche through and through, but its factory exhaust does not fully express that heritage. With this system installed the SUV gains the voice it was always meant to have, calm and relaxed when the valves are closed, sharp and aggressive when they are open. The balance between refinement and motorsport inspired sound makes every drive more engaging, whether you are covering highway miles or exploring back roads. At Valvetronic Designs we never compromise, and this exhaust system brings the same dedication to engineering and sound quality we apply to Porsche’s most race inspired platforms to the Cayenne 9Y0.

products.title: Valvetronic Designs Exhaust System for Porsche Carrera GT
bodyParagraphs: Porsche Carrera GT Valved F1-Style Double X-Pipe Exhaust System
The Ultimate Exhaust for the Ultimate Supercar

The Porsche Carrera GT is widely regarded as one of the greatest driver's cars ever created. Its naturally aspirated 5.7-liter V10 possesses one of the most iconic soundtracks in automotive history. Our objective was simple yet uncompromising: develop the finest exhaust system ever created for the Carrera GT—one that enhances every aspect of the factory experience while preserving the purity and character that make the car legendary.

Crafted entirely from premium-grade stainless steel, this Valved F1-Style Double X-Pipe Exhaust System has been engineered from the ground up to deliver the most exotic, high-pitched, naturally aspirated V10 sound possible, without introducing unwanted resonance, drone, or fatigue during extended journeys.
Engineering Without Compromise

The system begins with dual 3-inch (76mm) primary sections exiting the factory manifolds. These transition into carefully optimized x4 63mm sections before entering the centerpiece of the design: a bespoke double X-pipe crossover arrangement featuring dual 60mm crossover sections.

This architecture allows exhaust pulses from both cylinder banks to interact in a manner that enhances scavenging while creating the distinctive high-frequency harmonics associated with Formula 1-inspired exhaust systems.

Following the double X-pipe, the exhaust flow transitions into four individual 63mm sections before smoothly returning to dual 3-inch (76mm) outlets that connect directly to the factory exhaust tip locations within the rear bumper.
Every diameter, transition, crossover length, and merge point has been meticulously developed to achieve the ideal balance of flow characteristics, tonal quality, and acoustic refinement.
Configuration
Full stainless steel construction
Dual 3-inch (76mm) primary sections from factory manifolds
Optimized x4 63mm intermediate sections
Bespoke dual 60mm double X-pipe crossover design
Four individual 63mm secondary sections
Dual 3-inch (76mm) outlet configuration
Integrated valved acoustic control system
Direct-fit installation utilizing factory tip locations
Intelligent Valve Technology
Unlike conventional valved systems that route exhaust gases through heavily muffled bypass paths that suppress the engine's most desirable frequencies, our approach is fundamentally different.

The valves operate through carefully engineered diversion sections designed to preserve the Carrera GT's signature high-pitched exotic character. The objective was never to mute the car entirely, but rather to provide genuine flexibility when required.

With the valves open, the system delivers a breathtaking Formula 1-inspired soundtrack, rich in the raw mechanical frequencies that define the V10 experience. With the valves closed, sound levels are reduced sufficiently for early-morning starts, urban environments, and long-distance touring, while retaining the engine's unmistakable character.
Our goal: To Design for the Real World

The Carrera GT's carbon-fiber monocoque construction contributes significantly to its visceral driving experience, but it also means occupants are exposed to elevated levels of road noise, tire noise, and wind noise compared to modern supercars.
Recognizing this, a key development objective was ensuring the exhaust would never become intrusive during extended drives.
Extensive acoustic development focused on eliminating:
Cabin drone
Resonant frequencies
Low-frequency boom
Long-distance fatigue
The result is an exhaust that delivers maximum excitement when the throttle is opened, yet remains remarkably civilized during highway cruising and grand touring use.
The Sound of a Modern Classic, Perfected
This is not simply a louder exhaust system. It is a complete acoustic re-engineering of the Porsche Carrera GT experience.

Every aspect of the design has been developed to extract the most exotic, motorsport-inspired pitch from the V10 while maintaining refinement, usability, and comfort. The result is a soundtrack that feels sharper, more emotional, and more connected to the engine's racing-derived DNA.
For owners seeking the definitive Carrera GT exhaust system, this is the culmination of a singular goal:
To create the greatest exhaust system for the world's greatest sports car.
FITMENT
980 Porsche Carrera GT
